title: Mendeleev's periodic system announced
summary: Dmitri Mendeleev reported seeing a repeating pattern in the properties of elements ordered by atomic weight on 17 February 1869 (1 March in the Gregorian calendar). His periodic system was announced to the Russian physicochemical society a month later by Professor Menschutkin, because Mendeleev was ill. Its predictive power set it apart from earlier tables.

when.display: March 1869 (announced 6 March, calendar unspecified in sources)

uncertainty.note: The RSC dates the discovery to 17 February 1869 (Julian), equal to 1 March Gregorian, and the announcement to a month later; the RSC and OUP pages give 6 March without stating which calendar.

as_recorded.value: On 17 February 1869 (1 March in our Gregorian calendar)

importance.justification: Organising principle of chemistry that predicted undiscovered elements.
